_note: Copy for the 41 made-to-order laser-cut puzzles. `folder` is the source directory under a-ready-for-lebon-grace-website; `sub` is the nested Product-N folder where one directory holds several products. Titles are benefit-led, not keyword strings. Every description opens with a hook, gives one concrete reason to want it, and ends with the spec line the parent actually needs.

products.folder: Laser Cut Montessori Number Puzzle

products.desc: Ten hand-cut pieces pair each numeral with the dots that match it, so little fingers feel the difference between three and eight before they can say it. Cut and sanded to order in our workshop, edges smoothed by hand.
